newsitem.title: GREECE: Polls open in Greek national election.
newsitem.headline: Polls open in Greek national election.

text.p: Greeks went to the polls on Sunday to vote in a national election that pits the ruling Socialists against their conservative challengers in a neck and neck race.
About 8.5 million Greeks are required to cast a mandatory vote at polling stations around the country, which opened at sunrise, at 0413 GMT and will close at sunset, at 1620 GMT.
Pollsters say the election is a closely-run affair between pro-European socialist premier Costas Simitis, 60, and his conservative challenger Miltiadis Evert, 57.
Greek media will begin to broacast exit polls soon after polling stations close.
